description: Composable tone recipes, one layer at a time. A preset is built by stacking layers - amp + compressor + drive + eq + cab + delay + reverb - then adapting the values to the actual song. These are starting points to adjust, not answers to ship unchanged.

pr12.title: Dry PR12 factory baseline
pr12.use_when: starting from one of generate's PR12 factory baselines (clean, crunch or driven): makes it dry, as it was measured
pr12.note: Transpose 0, the amp's spring reverb 0, reverb, delay, tremolo, doubler and gate off, with the FX section itself on (so an effect turned back on is heard). Stack it first; turn an effect back on afterwards only with its parameters set explicitly, since the factory leftovers are extreme.

evidence.source: docs/clean-baseline-results.md, docs/crunch-baseline-results.md and docs/driven-baseline-results.md: the factory baselines were measured dry (render_preset_panel RULE_SET)

sw50r.title: Dry SW50R factory baseline
sw50r.use_when: starting from one of generate's SW50R factory baselines (clean, crunch or driven): makes it dry, as it was measured
sw50r.note: Transpose 0, the amp's spring reverb 0, reverb, delay, tremolo, doubler and gate off, with the FX section itself on (so an effect turned back on is heard). Stack it first; turn an effect back on afterwards only with its parameters set explicitly, since the factory leftovers are extreme.

evidence.source: docs/clean-baseline-results.md, docs/crunch-baseline-results.md and docs/driven-baseline-results.md: the factory baselines were measured dry (render_preset_panel RULE_SET)

ac20.title: Dry AC20 factory baseline
ac20.use_when: starting from one of generate's AC20 factory baselines (clean, crunch or driven): makes it dry, as it was measured
ac20.note: Transpose 0, reverb, delay, tremolo, doubler and gate off, with the FX section itself on (so an effect turned back on is heard). Stack it first; turn an effect back on afterwards only with its parameters set explicitly, since the factory leftovers are extreme.

evidence.source: docs/clean-baseline-results.md, docs/crunch-baseline-results.md and docs/driven-baseline-results.md: the factory baselines were measured dry (render_preset_panel RULE_SET)

crunch-pr12.title: PR12 crunch start: the labels' centre
crunch-pr12.use_when: generate's crunch start on PR12, after dry/pr12 on the factory crunch baseline
crunch-pr12.note: Apply on Artists/Keyan Houshmand/Modern Metal (Pick Hard).xml after dry/pr12. The centre of the trusted training labels for PR12 crunch (the ladder's Cen), with the output fitted to the baseline's loudness through two stock DIs (+7.0 -> +10.2 dB). Effects stay the baseline's dry ones, for research to set.

evidence.source: docs/preset-ladder-results.md, docs/ladder-ear-results.md
